source.citation: Laminar circular-section friction f_D = 64/Re (Hagen-Poiseuille), hence f_D L/D_h = 16 pi mu L/F
source.validRange: F about 1e-3 kg/s, L = 0.4 m, D_h = 3.99 mm and a liquid viscosity of at most 0.8 mPa s (estimate, 320-345 K) give Re <= 800 and f_D L/D_h <= 16, at most 1.3 % of K = 1250. The quadratic local loss is a contraction loss whose throat Reynolds number (throat about 0.9 mm) is about 2.5e3-4e3.
